articles.summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies achieve strong performance in robotic manipulation but remain brittle once execution deviates from nominal trajectories. articles.summary: Video world models enable interactive exploration of dynamic environments, yet struggle to respect prior observations over long horizons and across viewpoints. articles.summary: We need studies on conversational AI (CAI) at scale to understand human behavior and shape CAI design. articles.summary: Visual signals require compact yet sufficient representations for robust downstream prediction.
